name: av-equipment-lending-system
description: Full-Stack University AV Room Equipment Lending & Inventory System

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run prisma:db:push && npm --prefix backend run prisma:seed
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
